narrative_summary: The orderly pointed Hank at Walter's hidden phone. Walter's cover story is compromised and Hank starts asking questions.

actions.reason: The player told Hank where the phone is instead of hiding it.
Hank now knows Walter has a hidden phone, so the cover cannot be protected.
The orderly he trusted exposed him to a DEA agent.
A hidden phone does not fit a man who claims to remember nothing.

actions.description: Hank lifts the mattress, finds the burner phone and turns to Walter for an explanation.

actions.title: Decide what to tell Hank
actions.description: Hank wants to know how you found the phone. Tell him everything, or give Walter a way out.
